info.name: SINAI Baseline forecasts Carbon accounting API
Retrieve monthly, activity-level detailed emissions summaries

params.name: fiscal_year
params.description: Filter by a specific fiscal year, using the organization's fiscal start month setting

params.name: calendar_year
params.description: Filter by a specific calendar year

params.name: month
params.description: Filter by a specific month in YYYY-MM format

params.name: from_month
params.description: Filter starting at a specific month, inclusive. Can optionally use with to_month.

params.name: to_month
params.description: Filter up to a specific month, inclusive. Can optionally use with from_month.

params.name: process_ids
params.description: A list of process UUIDs to filter against, returning any summary that matches any process in the list

params.name: emissions_source_ids
params.description: A list of emissions source UUIDs, returning any summary that matches any emissions source in the list

params.name: scopes
params.description: Filter source types by GHG protocol scopes

items.docs: Use this endpoint to retrieve emissions summaries at month and activity levels.

info.name: Close an activity month for an emissions source

params.name: emissions_source_id
params.description: The ID of the emissions source to close the activity month for

params.name: month
params.description: The month to close in YYYY-MM format

items.docs: Closes an activity month for a specific emissions source, preventing further modifications to the period.

info.name: Open an activity month for an emissions source

params.name: emissions_source_id
params.description: The ID of the emissions source to open the activity month for

params.name: month
params.description: The month to open in YYYY-MM format

items.docs: Opens a previously closed activity month for a specific emissions source, allowing modifications to the period.
